question: Which county in Utah experienced the greatest percentage increase in construction employment from 2000 to 2018, calculated by averaging the employment levels during the third month of each quarter in those years? What is the corresponding percentage increase?
sql:
WITH utah_counties AS (
  SELECT geo_id AS geoid, county_name
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.geo_us_boundaries.counties`
  WHERE state_fips_code = '49'
),
y2000 AS (
  SELECT geoid, AVG(month3_emplvl_23_construction) AS avg_emplvl_2000
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.bls_qcew.2000_q1`
  WHERE geoid IN (SELECT geoid FROM utah_counties)
  GROUP BY geoid
  UNION ALL
  SELECT geoid, AVG(month3_emplvl_23_construction) AS avg_emplvl_2000
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.bls_qcew.2000_q2`
  WHERE geoid IN (SELECT geoid FROM utah_counties)
  GROUP BY geoid
  UNION ALL
  SELECT geoid, AVG(month3_emplvl_23_construction) AS avg_emplvl_2000
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.bls_qcew.2000_q3`
  WHERE geoid IN (SELECT geoid FROM utah_counties)
  GROUP BY geoid
  UNION ALL
  SELECT geoid, AVG(month3_emplvl_23_construction) AS avg_emplvl_2000
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.bls_qcew.2000_q4`
  WHERE geoid IN (SELECT geoid FROM utah_counties)
  GROUP BY geoid
),
y2018 AS (
  SELECT geoid, AVG(month3_emplvl_23_construction) AS avg_emplvl_2018
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.bls_qcew.2018_q1`
  WHERE geoid IN (SELECT geoid FROM utah_counties)
  GROUP BY geoid
  UNION ALL
  SELECT geoid, AVG(month3_emplvl_23_construction) AS avg_emplvl_2018
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.bls_qcew.2018_q2`
  WHERE geoid IN (SELECT geoid FROM utah_counties)
  GROUP BY geoid
  UNION ALL
  SELECT geoid, AVG(month3_emplvl_23_construction) AS avg_emplvl_2018
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.bls_qcew.2018_q3`
  WHERE geoid IN (SELECT geoid FROM utah_counties)
  GROUP BY geoid
  UNION ALL
  SELECT geoid, AVG(month3_emplvl_23_construction) AS avg_emplvl_2018
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.bls_qcew.2018_q4`
  WHERE geoid IN (SELECT geoid FROM utah_counties)
  GROUP BY geoid
),
avg_2000 AS (
  SELECT geoid, AVG(avg_emplvl_2000) AS avg_emplvl_2000
  FROM y2000
  GROUP BY geoid
),
avg_2018 AS (
  SELECT geoid, AVG(avg_emplvl_2018) AS avg_emplvl_2018
  FROM y2018
  GROUP BY geoid
)
SELECT uc.county_name, a2000.avg_emplvl_2000, a2018.avg_emplvl_2018,
       ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(a2018.avg_emplvl_2018 - a2000.avg_emplvl_2000, a2000.avg_emplvl_2000) * 100, 2) AS pct_increase
FROM utah_counties uc
JOIN avg_2000 a2000 ON uc.geoid = a2000.geoid
JOIN avg_2018 a2018 ON uc.geoid = a2018.geoid
ORDER BY pct_increase DESC
LIMIT 1
